report.headline: The PREVAIL trial of obicetrapib is forecast as likely to succeed based on a projected 18% relative risk reduction from LDL-C lowering, but the verdict carries caveats because follow-up duration and event count are unknown.
report.summary: PREVAIL has randomized 9,541 patients with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease on maximally tolerated lipid-lowering therapy and LDL-C >55 mg/dL, with a MACE primary endpoint. Obicetrapib lowered LDL-C by 31.9% (placebo-adjusted) in phase 3, with consistent reductions in apoB (-26.3%), non-HDL-C (-30.3%), and Lp(a) (-33.5%). The calculator projects an 18.2% relative risk reduction (HR 0.818) from an LDL-C reduction equivalent of 0.807 mmol/L, requiring 781 events for 80% power. However, follow-up duration is unknown, the low LDL-C entry threshold may reduce event rates, and the massive HDL-C increase (+136%) is not causal for benefit. A 20.5% increase in p-tau217 in ApoE4 carriers warrants monitoring. Confidence is medium.
key_evidence: LDL-C entry threshold 55 mg/dL (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05202509 PREVAIL)
Primary endpoint: Major Adverse Cardiovascular Effect (MACE) (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05202509 PREVAIL)
LDL-C reduction -31.9% in phase 3 (Fixed-dose combination of obicetrapib and ezetimibe for LDL cholesterol reduction (TANDEM): a phase 3, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.)
HDL-C increase +136.3% (Effect of obicetrapib, a potent cholesteryl ester transfer protein inhibitor, on p-tau217 levels in patients with cardiovascular disease.)
apoB reduction -26.3% (Obicetrapib as an Adjunct to Stable Statin Therapy in Japanese Subjects: Results from a Randomized Phase 2 Trial.)
non-HDL-C reduction -30.3% (Obicetrapib as an Adjunct to Stable Statin Therapy in Japanese Subjects: Results from a Randomized Phase 2 Trial.)
Lp(a) reduction -33.5% (Effect of obicetrapib, a potent cholesteryl ester transfer protein inhibitor, on p-tau217 levels in patients with cardiovascular disease.)
p-tau217 increase +20.5% in ApoE4 carriers (Effect of obicetrapib, a potent cholesteryl ester transfer protein inhibitor, on p-tau217 levels in patients with cardiovascular disease.)
CETP genetic association score 0.736 for CAD (opentargets:CETP)
Projected HR 0.818 (18.2% RRR) from LDL-C equivalent 0.807 mmol/L (calculator)
No adverse safety signals in phase 2 (Obicetrapib as an Adjunct to Stable Statin Therapy in Japanese Subjects: Results from a Randomized Phase 2 Trial.)
report.what_would_change_this: Confirm PREVAIL follow-up duration and projected event count; verify on-treatment LDL-C reduction in the PREVAIL population.
report.readthrough_note: Anacetrapib (REVEAL) succeeded via LDL-C lowering, supporting the LDL-C pathway for CETP inhibition; other Lp(a)-lowering programmes (e.g., olpasiran, pelacarsen) may provide complementary evidence on residual risk reduction.

issues.issue: LDL-C change of -29.9% from BROADWAY (f_800cf8bdb54d87) is marked placebo_adjusted: false. Calculator inputs must use placebo-adjusted values. issues.issue: Calculator notes 'follow-up unknown, effect shown at 5 years' but PREVAIL is event-driven (f_4b8d112aaec8ea). Median follow-up not yet public. This is a forecast limitation, not an input error.
issues.request: Add search for PREVAIL event-driven design details: target event count, expected median follow-up, enrollment completion date.

issues.issue: Calculator uses LDL-C -31.9% from TANDEM monotherapy (baseline ~100 mg/dL) applied to BROADWAY baseline 98 mg/dL, but PREVAIL entry threshold is LDL-C >55 mg/dL (f_7e039e85b2aae3) — substantially lower than BROADWAY (55-100 mg/dL with risk factors or >100 mg/dL, f_66af2f44748b2b) and TANDEM (>70 mg/dL, f_1cec50470dbd97). PREVAIL baseline LDL-C likely lower, so absolute LDL-C reduction (mmol/L) and expected HR will be overestimated. Need PREVAIL-specific baseline LDL-C or a justified adjustment.

issues.issue: Contradictory evidence on p-tau217 in ApoE4: f_bc522456ce1872 reports 20.48% increase (sign_set_by_code: 'sentence says increase') while f_afa767df391abb states 'obicetrapib reduced p-tau217 levels by a placebo-adjusted 20.48%' in ApoE4/E4. issues.request: Search full text of BROADWAY (pmcid:PMC12811769) for p-tau217 ApoE4 subgroup results to determine direction of effect. Update hypothesis accordingly.

issues.issue: Verifier reports 'not_found' for apoB (-26.3%), non-HDL-C (-30.3%), Lp(a) (-33.5%), HDL-C (136.3%) in abstracts, but these facts exist in verified facts with pmcid references (PMC11456355, PMC12811769). However, the case should explicitly flag that apoB/non-HDL-C are phase 2 week 8 (not phase 3 day 84) and Lp(a)/HDL-C are from BROADWAY (statin background) not PREVAIL population.
issues.request: Add explicit caveats in hypotheses and calculator inputs method fields: apoB/non-HDL-C from phase 2 week 8 (10 mg); Lp(a)/HDL-C from BROADWAY phase 3 day 84 (statin background). Note PREVAIL-specific biomarker data not yet available.

issues.request: Search for PREVAIL protocol publications, statistical analysis plan, or CTgov updates specifying follow-up duration and event-driven vs fixed design. Add as would_settle item.

issues.issue: Several 'against' points in hypotheses have empty refs arrays (e.g., 'Statin and PCSK9i trials showed benefit within 2-3 years at similar RRR', 'LDL-C remains causal at all levels; IMPROVE-IT, FOURIER, ODYSSEY showed benefit on top of statins at similar LDL-C'). issues.request: Add appropriate references for established CVOT results (FOURIER, ODYSSEY, IMPROVE-IT) and LDL-C causality evidence.

issues.issue: Calculator input for HDL-C change shows unit 'mg/dL' but pct_change 136.3% — unit should be consistent (percent) or baseline provided for absolute change.
